content.comment_body: Hello, We are developing a project using a [product_name] controller and a [product_name] communication module that operate a gate, allowing it to be opened or closed via SMS. The current setup has worked reliably, but the client wants to add some new functionality. Currently, there are preset SMS commands for opening the gate at specific positions, such as fully open, 25%, 50%, or 75% open, and fully closed. The client now wants more customizable position settings. My idea is to allow the SMS alias to accept a parameter, for example: OPEN XXX: 1234;[product_name]=VM0,XXX,WORD, where XXX would be the desired position. I have not found a way to implement this yet. Is it possible? Another question is about user management. Multiple users can operate the gate, and when someone sends a command, a confirmation SMS is sent to all users. Is there a way to identify the sender of the SMS so that the confirmation is sent only to the person who initiated the action? If there is a variable or method to store the user who sent the last SMS, I can create individual user groups. Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: A user manages a gate via SMS using [product_name] controller modules. Although the system works well, limitations have appeared: there is no way to dynamically set gate positions through SMS, and confirmation messages are sent to all users instead of just the sender. The user seeks guidance to enable customizable SMS commands and targeted confirmations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to enable the SMS control system to accept dynamic parameter values for gate position and wishes confirmation messages to be sent only to the user who issues the command.
